drafts.subject: Anne — a quick note from Summit Venture Studio
drafts.body:
Hi Anne,

Your work at 23andMe building one of the most consequential biotech platforms of the last decade — and your ongoing angel activity in healthcare — sits squarely in our university research commercialisation pipeline.

I'm Philippe — VP, Summit Venture Studio. Commercialises university-originated software; installs industry CEOs; milestone-gated capital; engineered for acquisition in ~3 years. Key facts: 200+ university partnerships | ~1,000 opps/month | ~90% ownership at formation | Fund I closed $10M | Target exit ~3 years.

I would value a 20-30 minute introductory call. If timing is off, I'm happy to send a Fund II summary and circle back.

Philippe M. Masindet
